submitted.rationale: EQE is highest on the Pb-rich side, with a peak near Sb 0.32–0.36. Index 3 (Sb=0.353) measured 0.0342%, slightly above index 2 (0.0328%). The Sb-rich compositions gave near-zero EQE. This fits the band gaps: Pb2Sb2O7 is about 2.5 eV and PbSb2O6 about 2.7 eV, both above the 2.1 eV photon energy. Pb-rich mixtures that likely contain PbO-type phases can absorb at 2.1 eV.
